caption: Crossroads
colour: red triangle, black crossroads symbol
explanation: Roads cross ahead with no priority shown; slow down, look both ways and be ready to give way to traffic on the other road.
mnemonic: Plus sign means roads plus across.
notes: Commons: 'Crossroads ahead' warning sign, TSRGD 504.1. OGL v1.0.

caption: T-junction
colour: red triangle, black T symbol
explanation: The road ahead ends at a T-junction; slow down and prepare to give way before turning left or right.
notes: Commons: 'T-junction ahead', TSRGD 505.1. In TSRGD since 1975.

caption: Staggered junction
colour: red triangle, black staggered-junction symbol
explanation: Side roads join from alternate sides a short distance apart; slow down and watch for traffic emerging from either side.
notes: Commons: 'Staggered junction ahead', TSRGD 507.1.

caption: Junction with priority over minor road
colour: red triangle, black T with thinner side road
explanation: A minor side road joins your road ahead and you have priority; stay alert in case a vehicle pulls out without giving way.
mnemonic: Thick road is yours, thin road yields.
notes: Commons: 'Side road ahead', TSRGD 506.1 (variant 1, right). Main road vertical, minor road joins from the right. OGL v1.0.

caption: Roundabout
colour: red triangle, three black curved arrows
explanation: A roundabout is ahead; slow down, get in the correct lane and give way to traffic already on the roundabout (from the right).
mnemonic: Three arrows chasing in a ring.
notes: Commons: 'Roundabout ahead', TSRGD 510. Clockwise roundabout warning.

caption: Distance to give way line ahead
colour: red triangle with inverted-triangle symbol, 'Give Way' plate
explanation: A give way line is the stated distance ahead; start slowing now so you can give way to traffic on the major road.
notes: Commons: 'Give way in 50 yards', TSRGD 503. Triangular warning with distance/Give Way plate.

caption: Distance to stop line ahead
colour: red triangle with 'STOP' plate showing distance
explanation: A compulsory STOP line is the stated distance ahead; slow down ready to stop completely at the line.
notes: Commons: 'Stop in 100 yards', TSRGD 502. Triangular warning with STOP/distance plate.

caption: Bend to the right
colour: red triangle, black right-curving arrow
explanation: The road bends sharply to the right ahead; reduce speed before the bend and keep to your side of the road.
mnemonic: Arrow leans the way the road goes.
notes: Commons: 'Bend ahead to the right', TSRGD 512. (Mirror 513 single-bend variant is left.)

caption: Double bend, first to the left
colour: red triangle, black S-shaped arrow bending left first
explanation: A double bend or series of bends ahead, the first to the left; slow down and stay in lane through the bends.
notes: Commons: 'Double bend or series of bends ahead, first to the left', TSRGD 513.

caption: Road narrows on both sides
colour: red triangle, black lines narrowing inward both sides
explanation: The road narrows from both sides ahead; slow down and be ready to give way or merge as the carriageway gets tighter.
notes: Commons: 'Road narrows on both sides ahead', TSRGD 516.

caption: Road narrows on the right
colour: red triangle, black line narrowing in from the right
explanation: The road narrows on the right-hand side ahead; slow down and watch for merging traffic from that side.
notes: Commons file is 'UK traffic sign 517 (right).svg' = 'Road narrows on right ahead', TSRGD 517. Plain UK_traffic_sign_517.svg is a redirect; using the exact (right) filename.

caption: Road narrows on the left
colour: red triangle, black line narrowing in from the left
explanation: The road narrows on the left-hand side ahead; slow down and watch for merging traffic from that side.
notes: Commons file is 'UK traffic sign 517 (left).svg' = 'Road narrows on left ahead (TSRGDNO 517L)'. TSRGD uses diagram 517 with the symbol reversed for the left case.

caption: Two-way traffic
colour: red triangle, two black vertical arrows (one up, one down)
explanation: Traffic ahead flows in both directions, often after a one-way section; keep left and do not overtake unless it is clear.
notes: Commons: 'Two-way traffic', TSRGD 521. Both arrows vertical (parallel).

caption: Two-way traffic crosses a one-way road
colour: red triangle, one vertical double-arrow crossing a horizontal up-arrow
explanation: Two-way traffic crosses the one-way road you are on ahead; slow down and look both ways before crossing the junction.
mnemonic: Up-down arrow cuts across a single arrow.
notes: Commons: 'Two-way traffic ahead across a one-way carriageway', TSRGD 522.

caption: Dual carriageway ends
colour: red triangle, black road symbol merging from two lanes to one
explanation: The dual carriageway ends and becomes a single two-way road ahead; reduce speed and expect oncoming traffic.
mnemonic: Two lanes pinch back into one.
notes: Commons: 'Dual carriageway ends ahead', TSRGD 520.

caption: Level crossing with barrier or gate ahead
colour: red triangle, black gate symbol
explanation: A railway level crossing with a barrier or gate is ahead; be ready to stop and never cross while lights flash or barriers are down.
mnemonic: Gate symbol means a gated crossing.
notes: Commons: 'Level crossing with gate or barrier ahead', TSRGD P 770. OGL v1.0.

caption: Level crossing without barrier or gate ahead
colour: red triangle, black steam-locomotive symbol
explanation: A railway level crossing with no barrier or gate is ahead; slow down, look and listen for trains and obey any signals before crossing.
notes: Commons: 'Railway level crossing without gate or barrier ahead', TSRGD P 771. Locomotive symbol.

caption: Trams crossing ahead
colour: red triangle, black tram symbol
explanation: Trams cross or run along the road ahead; slow down, give way to trams and watch for tram rails when turning.
notes: Commons: 'Tramcars crossing ahead', TSRGD P 772. OGL v1.0.

caption: Traffic signals ahead
colour: red triangle, black traffic-light symbol with red/amber/green
explanation: Traffic lights are ahead, sometimes where you would not expect them; slow down and be ready to stop if they change.
mnemonic: Mini traffic light in a triangle.
notes: Commons: 'Traffic signals ahead', TSRGD 543.

caption: Traffic queues likely ahead
colour: red triangle, black queue-of-vehicles symbol
explanation: Queuing traffic is likely on the road ahead; ease off early and be ready to stop to avoid running into the back of a queue.
notes: Commons: 'Traffic queues likely on road ahead', TSRGD 584.

caption: Road humps ahead
colour: red triangle, black road-hump (bump) symbol
explanation: Speed-reducing road humps are ahead; slow right down to cross them comfortably and safely.
notes: Commons: 'Road hump or series of road humps ahead', TSRGD 557.1.

caption: Uneven road
colour: red triangle, black bumpy/uneven road symbol
explanation: The road surface ahead is uneven or in poor condition; slow down to keep control and protect the bike.
notes: Commons: 'Uneven road ahead', TSRGD 556.
